name: Yokoshibahikari (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yokoshibahikari town emblem in blue, green and red: a blue stylised swoosh with a green leaf and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Yokoshibahikari, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Yokoshibahikari town emblem — a blue stylised swoosh with a green leaf and a red disc
